issues.detail: Missing error handling for API responses and edge cases such as rate limits or token expiration.
Excessive explanatory text and heuristics that could be trimmed for brevity.
Assumes Node.js environment with fetch and TypeScript; not portable to other runtimes.

scenarios.name: group-engagement-plan
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items (setup, screening, approval, rules, welcome, daily cadence) but misses tags, description, and privacy; Response B lacks many of those core details.

scenarios.name: page-posting-script
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers more rubric items, though still missing authentication steps and using wrong metrics, whereas Response A is incomplete and also lacks authentication steps.

scenarios.name: ads-campaign-creation
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items, missing only schedule, placements, and CTA, while Response B omits ad creative and ad creation entirely.
